For example, "Foxtrot, let's name each other for escorts every round for the 5 points." If my proposed partner ignores the pact or posts generic notes in response, I will switch my proposal to a different active boat in the next round.

When I am asked to fire, I target the boat dictated by the standing order to avoid drawing unnecessary retaliation, picking a random cell from 1 to 9. I do not fire on Harbor unless I am prepared to be removed from the board, as their standing signal threatens.

I always name the active boat I proposed a mutual escort pact with in the note stage, or the boat that proposed one to me, to secure the 5-point mutual payout. I must monitor my score; if I am not receiving the 5-point bonus, it means they are not reciprocating, and I will switch my escort claim to a different live boat.
